title: Pathways of Visual Information Flow in Vision-Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2607.03358v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We study how visual information is routed in vision-language models (VLMs). Using causal patching on controlled synthetic and natural datasets, we find that models rely on two distinct pathways to solve visual tasks: A direct pathway, where visual information is retained in image token representations and read out by the final token at later layers, and a text-mediated pathway, where visual information is first transferred to the query tokens and then read out by the final token. Across three visual tasks, we show that pathway selection is task-dependent, and that data distribution and prompt design can also modulate which pathway is used to solve the image-based query. Moreover, using attention knockouts and corrupted-input patching, we find that these pathways are flexible, under certain interventions, models can rely on the text-mediated pathway as a fallback when the usual pathway is ablated. This behavior unifies findings

translated_title: 视觉-语言模型中视觉信息流动的通路
translated_abstract: 我们研究视觉信息在视觉-语言模型（VLMs）中是如何被路由的。通过在受控的合成与自然数据集上使用因果补丁技术，我们发现模型依赖两种不同的通路来解决视觉任务：一种是直接通路，即视觉信息保留在图像token的表示中，并在后续层中被最后一个token读取；另一种是文本中介通路，即视觉信息首先被传递到查询token，然后由最后一个token读取。在三个视觉任务上，我们表明通路的选择依赖于具体任务，且数据分布和提示词设计也可以调节使用哪条通路来解决基于图像的查询。此外，通过注意力敲除和受损输入补丁方法，我们发现这些通路是灵活的——在某些干预下，当常用通路被消融时，模型可以依赖文本中介通路作为后备机制。这一行为统一了相关发现……
tldr: 该研究发现视觉-语言模型通过“直接通路”和“文本中介通路”两条不同路径处理视觉信息，通路选择取决于任务类型、数据分布和提示设计，且在常用通路被消融时模型能灵活启用文本中介通路作为后备。
en_tdlr: This study reveals that vision-language models solve visual tasks via two distinct pathways—a direct pathway and a text-mediated pathway—with pathway selection modulated by task, data distribution, and prompt design, and models can flexibly fall back to the text-mediated pathway when the usual pathway is ablated.
